title: HELIX Bridge: Salesforce → Person
architecture_notes: Contact is the person. Salesforce holds people the SIS doesn't (inquiries, parents, donors), so silver must resolve each Contact to an existing HELIX Person or create one. Match on the SIS ID field the institution adds to Contact first, then email plus birth date; send ambiguous matches to the stewardship queue.

source_objects.description: The person record in every Salesforce higher ed model: students, prospects, parents, alumni, donors.
Agentforce Education: ethnicity, citizenship, birthplace, and similar profile details.
Household, administrative, or educational institution account the contact belongs to.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Use the HELIX ID of the matched Person; create a deterministic UUID from institution_id + Contact.Id only when no match exists.

attribute_mappings.source: Contact.Id; SIS ID custom field (for example Contact.Student_ID__c); EDA Contact.hed__... IDs
attribute_mappings.transformation: Array: {system: salesforce, type: erp_internal_key, value: 18-character Contact.Id} plus {system: sis, type: institutional_id, value: SIS ID}. VALIDATE the SIS ID field name.

attribute_mappings.source: Contact.FirstName, LastName, MiddleName, Salutation, Suffix; preferred name field
attribute_mappings.transformation: Map to name.given, family, middle, prefix, suffix; preferred name (EDA hed__Chosen_Full_Name__c or a local field) to name.preferred_first.

attribute_mappings.source: Contact.GenderIdentity or a local gender field / ContactProfile
attribute_mappings.transformation: Map through helix/gender via a crosswalk.

attribute_mappings.source: ContactProfile ethnicity and race fields (Agentforce Education) or EDA hed__Ethnicity__c, hed__Race__c
ContactProfile citizenship fields or EDA hed__Citizenship__c
EDA hed__Primary_Language__c or a local field
Contact.Email, hed__AlternateEmail__c, hed__UniversityEmail__c, Phone, MobilePhone, MailingAddress
attribute_mappings.transformation: Emails typed institutional or personal; phones typed mobile or home; mailing address. Respect HasOptedOutOfEmail and DoNotCall in communication preferences downstream.

extraction_methods.description: Default. SOQL by SystemModstamp high-water mark; queryAll to include deleted rows. Included with API-enabled editions.
Near real-time change events for objects that need freshness. A limited number of objects is included; more needs an add-on. Check your contract.
AWS-managed Salesforce to S3 flows, scheduled or event-triggered. Priced per flow run and data processed on the AWS side.
Only if the institution already licenses Salesforce Data 360. Not required for HELIX.

validate: Object and field names follow Salesforce's published Agentforce Education (formerly Education Cloud), EDA, NPSP, and standard object models, but orgs add custom fields and record types. VALIDATE every field against your org's describe output before building extracts; custom fields end in __c.
